feature: Consolidate zones into unified permanents zone
workflow_rationale: Architectural refactor of existing zone infrastructure to align with FAB Comprehensive Rules CR 3.0.5. No new game features — existing behavior must be preserved via SubZoneView backward compatibility. The change adds a new zone model alongside the old (via SubZoneView), migrates consumers, then the old separate Zone instances are simply removed from Player.__init__.

phases.name: Core Data Model — SubZoneView + Permanents Zone
phases.description: Build the foundation: add permanent_subtype to Card, create SubZoneView class, refactor Player.__init__ to use a single permanents Zone with sub-zone property accessors, and update all Player helper methods. After this phase, player.items/auras/allies/tokens/soul still work as SubZoneView instances while the underlying storage is a single permanents Zone.

subtasks.description: Add permanent_subtype field to Card dataclass
subtasks.notes: Add `permanent_subtype: Optional[str] = None` to the Card dataclass after the zone tracking fields (around line 76). This is a lightweight string tag ('Item', 'Aura', 'Ally', 'Token', 'Soul') used by SubZoneView._matches() to filter cards. Must not break Card serialization (to_dict/from_dict). Also add it to Card.to_dict() output and Card.remember_last_known_state() if relevant.

verification.command: python -c "from engine.card import Card; c = Card(slug='test', name='Test'); c.permanent_subtype = 'Item'; assert c.permanent_subtype == 'Item'; print('OK')"

patterns_from: engine/state.py lines 34-120 (Zone class API — SubZoneView must mirror this interface)
subtasks.notes: Create SubZoneView class ABOVE the Player class in state.py (after Zone class, around line 120). Must support: .cards (filtered list), .add() (sets permanent_subtype then delegates to parent), .remove() (delegates to parent), .find(), .find_all(), .extend(), .name (returns subtype name for backward compat), .owner_id, .is_public, .slugs, .top, .to_dict(), __len__, __bool__, __iter__, __repr__. The _matches() method should use permanent_subtype as the PRIMARY filter to avoid duplicates (e.g., aura tokens have both 'Token' and 'Aura' in types). Soul uses permanent_subtype='Soul' exclusively since soul cards retain their original types.

verification.command: python -c "from engine.state import Zone, SubZoneView; from engine.card import Card; z = Zone('permanents', 1); sv = SubZoneView(z, 'Item'); c = Card(slug='test', name='Test', types=['Item']); sv.add(c); assert len(sv) == 1; assert c.zone == 'permanents'; assert c.permanent_subtype == 'Item'; print('OK')"
